tiles.title: Income, 2025
tiles.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) AS income FROM company_finances WHERE type = 'Income' AND year(date) = 2025

tiles.title: Expenses, 2025
tiles.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) AS expenses FROM company_finances WHERE type = 'Expense' AND year(date) = 2025

tiles.title: Net profit, 2025
tiles.sql: SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN type = 'Income' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 2) AS net_profit FROM company_finances WHERE year(date) = 2025

tiles.title: Owed to us
tiles.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount + tax), 2) AS owed FROM company_finances WHERE type = 'Income' AND status <> 'Paid'

tiles.title: Income and expenses by month
tiles.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', date) AS month,
       round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Income'), 2) AS income,
       round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Expense'), 2) AS expenses
FROM company_finances
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY month

tiles.title: Spend by category, 2025
tiles.sql:
SELECT category, round(sum(amount), 2) AS spend
FROM company_finances
WHERE type = 'Expense' AND year(date) = 2025
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY spend DESC

tiles.title: Unpaid invoices by age
tiles.sql:
WITH unpaid AS (
  SELECT amount + tax AS total,
         (SELECT max(date) FROM company_finances) - due_date AS days_late
  FROM company_finances
  WHERE type = 'Income' AND status <> 'Paid'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN days_late <= 0 THEN '0 days (not yet due)'
            WHEN days_late <= 30 THEN '1-30 days late'
            WHEN days_late <= 60 THEN '31-60 days late'
            WHEN days_late <= 90 THEN '61-90 days late'
            ELSE '90+ days late' END AS age,
       round(sum(total), 2) AS owed,
       count(*) AS invoices
FROM unpaid
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY min(days_late)
